stage: RACE Stage 1: Simple Prediction Headroom Test
objective: Test whether simple causal routing predictors plus one common eviction rule capture most of the frozen Stage 0 offline-oracle advantage.

frozen_data.calibration_workload: exact stage0 calibration_workload record and ordering
frozen_data.evaluation_workloads: exact ten stage0 workloads records and orderings

inherited_cache_semantics.cache_namespaces: one independent cache per MoE layer
inherited_cache_semantics.expert_identity: (layer_id, expert_id); expert_id values are local to a layer
inherited_cache_semantics.request_semantics: all eight experts in a layer event inspect the same pre-event resident set
inherited_cache_semantics.admission: all current-request misses are mandatory admissions
inherited_cache_semantics.post_event_state: complete current atomic request union selected experts retained from the pre-event resident set

timing_and_scores.persistence: At event t, score with the previous same-layer request R_(t-1); update the stored request only after the retention decision.
timing_and_scores.last_gate: For an old candidate, use its most recently observed gate weight from event t or earlier; never-observed experts score zero.
timing_and_scores.gate_ewma: For every same-layer event, g <- alpha*g + (1-alpha)*w, with w zero for unrequested experts; the current event update precedes retention.
timing_and_scores.markov: Use the current atomic request and a calibration-fitted immutable transition matrix to score demand after the current event.
timing_and_scores.markov_h_target: Expert appears at least once in the next H same-layer events on the frozen calibration path.
timing_and_scores.hybrid: beta*selected Markov-H probability + (1-beta)*request-indicator EWMA using alpha 0.95.

shared_prediction_policy.eligible_candidates: experts in the pre-event resident set but absent from the current request
shared_prediction_policy.selection: retain up to capacity minus current request size
shared_prediction_policy.ranking: prediction score descending, then LRU recency descending, then expert ID ascending

calibration_selection.fit_data: all events on the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path only
calibration_selection.selection_cost: unit misses summed across capacities 12,16,24,32 on that calibration path
calibration_selection.gate_ewma_alpha: one global alpha minimizing calibration selection cost
calibration_selection.markov_h: one global H minimizing calibration selection cost
calibration_selection.hybrid_beta: one global beta minimizing calibration selection cost after Markov-H selection
calibration_selection.verdict_predictor: one global predictor family/configuration minimizing calibration selection cost among the six causal families
calibration_selection.tie_break: fixed predictor order as listed in causal_predictors, then smaller numeric hyperparameter
calibration_selection.note: Fitting and selection both use calibration, which deliberately gives simple predictors a strong chance; no evaluation event influences fitting or selection.

diagnostics.limited_lookahead: Exact receding finite-horizon retention for equal unit miss cost: after serving event t, retain old candidates in increasing next-use order when that use lies within the next H same-layer events. No terminal value and no prefetch.
diagnostics.perfect_score_simple_policy: same simple retention mechanism scored by the exact next future use over the entire remaining same-layer stream
diagnostics.validation: first actions and costs are checked against exact small-state dynamic programming; covering the remaining trace must reproduce full-oracle cost

prediction_quality.markov_h_additional_target: at least one appearance in the selected next-H same-layer window

statistics.paired_unit: source decode sequence, stratified by domain
statistics.primary_suite_aggregation: At each capacity, sum raw costs across all ten frozen workload paths; no per-capacity or per-regime causal-method reselection.
statistics.regime_results: also report stationary, abrupt, repeated, and mixed aggregates separately
statistics.conditionality: Intervals reweight saved per-sequence contributions conditional on each frozen stateful workload path; stateful cache trajectories are not regenerated under reordered bootstrap workloads.

metrics.zero_gap_handling: GapClosed is null/N/A when C_simple equals C_oracle; capacity 8 never enters the verdict.

decision_rule.primary_basis: frozen ten-workload-suite aggregate at each non-degenerate capacity
decision_rule.precedence: NO_GO if either NO_GO trigger holds; otherwise STRONG_GO if both STRONG_GO conditions hold; otherwise WEAK_GO.
